lastCompletedStory.title: Add cam suggestions promote + dismiss subcommands

nextStoryContext: US-005 is DONE: `cam suggestions` now has all 3 subcommands (list/promote/dismiss), so US-006 (update orchestrator agent docs to describe the pen + triage) is purely a docs story -- no more suggestions.ts/index.ts CLI surface work remains in this PRD. `src/commands/suggestions.ts` exports `promoteSuggestionOnMain`/`dismissSuggestionOnMain` (alongside the existing `appendSuggestionOnMain`/`readSuggestionsFromMain`, US-001/US-003): `dismissSuggestionOnMain({cwd, fingerprint, spawnFn})` just removes the matching JSONL line (checkMainUpToDate -> read pen -> removeSuggestionLine -> commitTreeToMain -> pushMainBestEffort); `promoteSuggestionOnMain({cwd, fingerprint, spawnFn, clock, readProjectToml})` looks up the entry FIRST (unknown fingerprint -> not-found, zero mutation), calls `createLocalIssueOnMain` (title=entry.title, description hand-built to match `buildFollowUpIssue`'s line format but reusing entry.fingerprint verbatim -- never recomputed, since the pen entry has no file/line to reconstruct a ReviewFinding from -- derivedFrom=[resolveIssueId(entry.sourceIssue, prefix)] when resolvable), then re-runs checkMainUpToDate + re-reads the pen a SECOND time (main advanced from the issue-file commit) before removing the line. `index.ts`'s `dispatchSuggestions` routes `promote`/`dismiss` via injectable `promoteFn`/`dismissFn` (mirroring `readFn`), printing `CAM_SUGGESTIONS_PROMOTED=<fp> issue=<id>` / `CAM_SUGGESTIONS_DISMISSED=<fp>` on success and nothing (just exit 1) on failure -- printError already fires inside suggestions.ts, dispatch does not double-print. For US-006: the orchestrator persona docs to update are `templates/.claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md` (source of truth) + its `.claude/` runtime mirror (self-hosting dual-copy pattern, patterns.md's `cam-dual-copy-is-per-file` bullet -- diff before assuming a change forces re-embed; this IS a template file so it likely needs `bun run embed-vendor` afterward, check file-size on `src/vendor/_generated.ts` too) -- describe the CAM-189 terminal-verdict hook filing to the pen (not directly as issues), and the `cam suggestions list/promote/dismiss` triage workflow now fully available. No new suggestions.ts/index.ts code should be touched by US-006.
